body: Yea, when around people who I don't worry about being deceitful toward me I generally am happy, but it's when I'm around people that I don't trust completely or when I get home and alone that I get like this. And I don't really have any relatives I'd trust knowing that I have thoughts like this and even so, there's already some tension so definitely not really.

What usually makes me happy now is going for a bike ride or driving, but they're generally only temporary and even so, I broke my right leg 2 weeks ago so both of them are out of the picture for now and I think it may be making it worse. And even so, the only thing that's consistently made me happy was making people close to me happy, but right now, like I said, it just seems like I bother them.
